sentence: This project processes human samples and uses advanced analysis methods to study trigeminal neurons that connect to the temporomandibular joint.
This project uses pseudoviruses and immunizations of mice to build a lab-based model that predicts how a virus evolves to escape antibodies.
This project studies how the oxytocin system in mice adapts to and guides maternal care by single mothers and by groups raising pups together.
This project builds AI algorithms that link genotype and epigenetics to phenotype and find key driver proteins to target in complex diseases.
This project tries to find out how cells communicate with each other during intestinal healing in inflammatory bowel disease.
This project develops technologies that measure hyperphosphorylated tau in the living brain more accurately with neuroimaging.
This project uses a Drosophila tumor model to study how polyploidy and sex dimorphism affect tumor growth and progression.
This project tries to find and isolate T cell receptors that recognize JC virus and tests whether T cells with them can clear the infection.
This project tries to find out how exhausted T cells are held back during chronic viral infections and cancer.
This project builds fast detectors and computational algorithms to make positron emission images directly, without a tomographic reconstruction step.
This project builds machine-learning models that predict regulatory variants in the human genome and tests the predictions in experiments.
This project tries to find out whether activating low-affinity T cells that target a fusion peptide can create lasting immunity against leukemia.
This project oversees the measurement and storage of biomarker samples, such as blood, urine and DNA, for a long-term study of aging and dementia.
This project tries to find out how genetic risk variants for lupus cause B cell dysfunction, using genomics and CRISPR-based approaches.
This project develops an AI framework that turns the genetic causes of Alzheimer's disease into useful information for other researchers.
This project develops a workflow that combines magnetic particle imaging with magnetic fluid hyperthermia to plan treatment in small animal models.
This project designs and pilot-tests a technology-driven system that helps home healthcare nurses improve the quality of their clinical documentation.
This project develops a peptide vaccine that triggers a T cell response to shrink atherosclerotic lesions or steady atherosclerotic plaques.
This project tries to find out how one gene affects the function of neurons and how its dysfunction leads to neurological disease, using mouse models.
